# Typography

One family (Open Sans, fallback Arial). Nine styles from `system/typography`. In Figma they are text styles; in CSS each is a `font` shorthand: `font: var(--typography-body)`.

| Style | Size | Weight | Line height | Use | CSS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `display` | 48px | 500 | 125% | Hero titles, one per page | `font: var(--typography-display)` |
| `heading-1` | 40px | 500 | 125% | Page title (h1) | `font: var(--typography-heading-1)` |
| `heading-2` | 32px | 500 | 125% | Section titles | `font: var(--typography-heading-2)` |
| `heading-3` | 24px | 600 | 125% | Sub-sections, panel titles | `font: var(--typography-heading-3)` |
| `heading-4` | 20px | 600 | 125% | Card and list titles | `font: var(--typography-heading-4)` |
| `body` | 16px | 400 | 150% | Running text | `font: var(--typography-body)` |
| `body-sm` | 14px | 400 | 150% | Secondary text, captions in cards | `font: var(--typography-body-sm)` |
| `label` | 16px | 600 | 150% | Form labels, buttons, table headers | `font: var(--typography-label)` |
| `caption` | 12px | 400 | 150% | Notes, metadata | `font: var(--typography-caption)` |

Rules: one h1 per page; do not skip heading levels; body text at reading width (`layout.reading-width`, 640 px); line height in percent in tokens (Figma), unitless in CSS.
